title: Dropbox synced folder
whyItMatters: Dropbox keeps a local copy of synced files. Those copies can contain private documents even after the account is signed out.
source: Dropbox on File Provider moves the folder to ~/Library/CloudStorage/Dropbox - https://www.macforensics.app/en/artifacts/cloud-storage-clients
notes: Newer File Provider installs only. Legacy ~/Dropbox may be a symlink to this folder; the path jail never follows links. Online-only placeholders are not hydrated.
